class.name: ReloadedPlugin
class.brief_description: A plugin of Rails Reloaded: what it is for the player, and what it adds to the core.
class.description: A plugin brings its classes and servers to the core at two points of the library's start: its classes once every core class is registered, since they derive from them; its servers once the vehicle servers exist and before the servers that follow model instances. Its servers go in reverse at the same point of the library's end. [ReloadedPluginServer] holds the plugins. Its part of the game - the providers it gives the core - is a [code]ReloadedRuntimePlugin[/code] of its addon ([member runtime_script]), which the core's [code]ReloadedPlugins[/code] puts in the tree before the main scene, as the editor holds [EditorPlugin]s: it registers them in its [code]_enter_tree()[/code] and unregisters them in its [code]_exit_tree()[/code].

members.member: What the plugin brings, for the player.
The plugin's logo, loaded from its addon when its servers are created.
The plugin's name, for the player.
The path of the plugin's [code]ReloadedRuntimePlugin[/code] script, set when the plugin is created; empty for none.
